title: Customers with a big order
prompt: Return the names of customers who have placed at least one order with amount greater than 100 (use a subquery with IN).
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE cust5 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT); INSERT INTO cust5 VALUES (1,'Alice'),(2,'Bob'),(3,'Carol'); CREATE TABLE ord5 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER, amount REAL); INSERT INTO ord5 VALUES (1,1,150.0),(2,2,40.0),(3,3,200.0),(4,1,20.0);
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM cust5 WHERE id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM ord5 WHERE amount > 100);
